citation.authors: Meek CL, Lewis HB, Burling K, Reimann F, Gribble F
citation.title: Expected values for gastrointestinal and pancreatic hormone concentrations in healthy volunteers in the fasting and postprandial state

reported.what: expected ranges of glucose and insulin, fasting and to 240 min after a standardized liquid mixed meal (Ensure Plus) and after a 75 g OGTT, n = 28; the values are only in Figures 1 and 2 and supplementary Tables S1 and S2, not in the XML

location.where: Results, paragraph 1; Figures 1 and 2; Tables S1 and S2
location.quote: Data from these 28 participants were used to create ranges of expected values for glucose, insulin, glucagon, total GLP-1, PYY, GIP and FFA before and after an OGTT and SMT (see Figures 1 and 2; Tables S1 and S2).

reported.what: the spread of every reported range is the 2.5th and 97.5th percentile of the sample; no mean and no SD or SEM is printed

location.quote: The 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles were calculated to give an interval which included 95% of values from this sample.

reported.what: C-peptide and intact proinsulin after the OGTT, n = 20, only in Figure 2 (the Figure 1 legend places them in the OGTT figure)

location.quote: C-peptide and intact proinsulin were measured following an OGTT only (n = 20 participants; Figure 2).

detail: The paper's only expected values for glucose and insulin are 2.5th to 97.5th percentile limits of one sample, which the model's uncertainty kinds (sd, sem, ci, range, n_only) cannot hold, and the numbers themselves are in figures and a supplement that are not in the paper's XML.
